lines.speaker: System
lines.text: NOTICE: F-RANK REENTRY PAPERWORK ACCEPTED. Social damage pending.

lines.speaker: Dain
lines.text: So the ghost came back and immediately picked a wolf job. Brave. Or cheap.

lines.speaker: Bin
lines.text: Those can be the same thing if the guild refuses to pay a living wage.

lines.speaker: Peri
lines.text: Audience note: public humiliation routes may produce Jester Points. Try not to die before the punchline.

ops.note: Bin refused the bait before Frostwood.

ops.text: Bin ignored Dain and kept the party focused on the Frostwood job.

successOps.text: Bin roasted Dain hard enough that the guild counted it as public service.

failOps.text: Bin's comeback arrived late and in poor condition.

choices.label: Spend 1 JP to scan for a side lead

ops.text: CJS scan revealed an unstable resource lead deeper in Frostwood.

lines.speaker: Bowy
lines.text: Tracks split ahead. Wolves went north, something heavy dragged east, and the creek looks like it hates ankles.

lines.speaker: Mitia
lines.text: The snow is too quiet. Not empty quiet. Listening quiet.

lines.speaker: Bin
lines.text: Good. If the forest is listening, it can hear my formal complaint.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: ROUTE LOOP ONLINE: explore, survive, loot, upgrade, make a questionable decision, repeat.

choices.label: Mark the route and move carefully

ops.text: The party marked Frostwood Edge as the route start.
Bin weaponized false confidence. It helped more than it should have.

lines.speaker: Garr
lines.text: Small fire. Low smoke. No loud victory stories until we are behind a wall.

lines.speaker: Bowy
lines.text: So Bin's normal talking volume is banned.

lines.speaker: Bin
lines.text: My normal talking volume is a tactical resource.

lines.speaker: Peri
lines.text: CAMPFIRE FUNCTIONS AVAILABLE: rest, cook, craft, inventory panic, emotionally suspicious silence.

ops.text: The party used the Frostwood campfire for a cautious rest.
The party kept the fire low and talked long enough to remember why they came together.
Campfire services are available from this node: cook, craft, inventory, and camp chat.

lines.speaker: Mitia
lines.text: There is stardust in the old stone, but something small is hiding beside it.

lines.speaker: Bowy
lines.text: Wolf pup. Mother is close, or the pack left it as bait.

lines.speaker: Bin
lines.text: The correct answer to 'bait with feelings' is usually 'walk away,' which is why this job pays badly.

choices.label: Spare the pup and give it space

ops.text: The party spared the wolf pup. The pack noticed.

choices.label: Drive it off before the pack arrives

ops.text: The party drove the pup away and prepared for the pack.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: ROUTE OBJECTIVE REACHED. Shrine silence is not a warranty.

lines.speaker: Garr
lines.text: Quiet enough to call the route clear. Not quiet enough to trust.

lines.speaker: Bin
lines.text: That is the most northern sentence anyone has ever said.

ops.note: The party reached the old shrine route marker.

ops.text: The old shrine route was marked clear.
The spared wolf pup's trail revealed a safer path and a dust pocket.
